title: Rupturing Blade
summary: +1 rapier trades self-damage for Fire damage and two separate conditions.

fields.Weapon: Martial, one-handed finesse, 5 ft melee. 1d8 + 1 Piercing plus Strength or Dexterity. +1 to attack rolls.
fields.Searing Blood: Action once per Short Rest with proficiency. On a melee hit deal weapon damage, plus 1d6 Fire and proficiency bonus Fire in separate instances. You take 1d6 self-damage. The action description and notes say Slashing, while its data table says Piercing. The target makes two Constitution saves against weapon-action DC +2, separately preventing Bleeding and Burning for 2 turns. Each damage instance can trigger riders, including the self-hit, even in Honour Mode.
fields.Bleeding and Burning: Bleeding deals 2 Slashing at turn start and gives Disadvantage on Constitution saves. Healing clears it. Burning deals 1d4 Fire per turn and can be cleared by Help, a healing potion or becoming Wet.
fields.Piercing Strike: Action once per Short Rest with proficiency. Deal weapon damage. Constitution save against weapon-action DC +2 or Gaping Wounds for 2 turns. Undead and constructs are immune. Hits add 2 Piercing. In Honour Mode any damage source instead gains +2 of its original type. Healing clears it.
fields.Weakening Strike: Action once per Short Rest with proficiency. Nonlethal 1d4 weapon-type damage plus attack ability modifier. Strength save against weapon-action DC +2 or Weak Grip for 2 turns. Unarmed creatures are immune. Weak Grip gives Disadvantage on attacks and Strength saves. Help clears it.
fields.Flourish: Bonus Action once per Short Rest with proficiency. Nonlethal 1d4 Bludgeoning. Dexterity save against weapon-action DC +2 or Off Balance for 2 turns. The target has Disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity checks, and attackers have Advantage. Damage or Help clears it.
fields.Acquisition: Sold by Brem after Find the Missing Shipment.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and exact item and dependency citations.
